{"metadata":{"description":"Multi-window wall for DeepSeek Harness: run & monitor N DSH conversations side-by-side in one screen, plus an authenticated LAN gateway for phone/tablet access. npx dsh-multi-chat install","id":"gh:1335578860","install_available":true,"language":"TypeScript","name":"dsh-multi-chat","slug":"daetz-coder/dsh-multi-chat","topics":["deepseek-harness","dsh","dsh-plugin"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"Multi-window wall for DeepSeek Harness: run & monitor N DSH conversations side-by-side in one screen"},{"id":"p1s2","text":", plus an authenticated LAN gateway for phone/tablet access. npx dsh-multi-chat install"},{"id":"p2s1","text":"# 💬 dsh-multi-chat — Multi-chat, one screen"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"**English** | 中文"},{"id":"p4s1","text":"> **Run N conversations in DeepSeek Harness at once, watch every Agent's live progress side-by-side,"},{"id":"p4s2","text":" and check in from your phone or tablet.** One browser tab goes from "one conversation at a time" to"},{"id":"p4s3","text":" "a panoramic multi-conversation cockpit.""},{"id":"p5s1","text":"Install a **multi-window wall** into the official DeepSeek Harness (DSH) Web UI: a grid that shows N"},{"id":"p5s2","text":" running DSH conversation instances simultaneously (each instance runs its own task), so every Agent"},{"id":"p5s3","text":"'s live progress, chat, and output are **visible at a glance** — no more hopping between endless tab"},{"id":"p5s4","text":"ss, chat, and output are **visible at a glance** — no more hopping between endless tabs and windows."},{"id":"p6s1","text":"## ✨ What it does"},{"id":"p7s1","text":"| Capability | Description |"},{"id":"p8s1","text":"| 📺 **Multi-window** | One-click entry from the sidebar; the chat area becomes a window grid showing"},{"id":"p8s2","text":" every task side-by-side, one pane per port |
| 🔍 **Auto-discovery** | Scans a port range to auto-fi"},{"id":"p8s3","text":"nd running DSH instances; manual management is also supported |
| ➕ **One-click new window** | Launc"},{"id":"p8s4","text":"h a brand-new DSH instance right inside the wall to grow your conversation matrix |
| 📱 **Phone acce"},{"id":"p8s5","text":"ss** | The "Phone access" button starts a **built-in authenticated LAN gateway** — open the URL on y"},{"id":"p8s6","text":"our phone, enter the token, and watch progress |
| 🛑 **Window controls** | Maximize, refresh, open i"},{"id":"p8s7","text":"n a new tab, stop an instance, and switch column count (auto/1/2/3/4/6) |"},{"id":"p9s1","text":"> **Multi-chat = multi-port.** Start N `dsh web --port <n>` instances (each running one conversation"},{"id":"p9s2","text":"/task), open the wall from any of them, and you see all of them side-by-side."},{"id":"p10s1","text":"## 📸 Screenshots"},{"id":"p11s1","text":"**🖥️ Windows · Two chats side-by-side** — two running DSH instances laid out together, each pane a f"},{"id":"p11s2","text":"ull official conversation UI with live online status dots and per-window controls (maximize / refres"},{"id":"p11s3","text":"h / new tab / remove):"},{"id":"p12s1","text":"**📱 iPad · Two chats on mobile** — on the same LAN, open the token-authenticated gateway URL on an i"},{"id":"p12s2","text":"Pad to watch two Agents' live progress on one tablet screen:"},{"id":"p13s1","text":"**🖥️ Windows · Three-chat panorama** — a 3-column grid of three running instances, all Agents on one"},{"id":"p13s2","text":" screen, upgrading you from "one conversation at a time" to "a panoramic multi-conversation cockpit""},{"id":"p13s3","text":"screen, upgrading you from "one conversation at a time" to "a panoramic multi-conversation cockpit":"},{"id":"p14s1","text":"## 🚀 30-second quick start"},{"id":"p15s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p16s1","text":"## Why this approach"},{"id":"p17s1","text":"- **No official logic is touched**: the plugin only registers two **additive list slots** (`conversa"},{"id":"p17s2","text":"tion.view` ring entry, `sidebar.footer.action` sidebar shortcut) and five read-only JSON routes (`/m"},{"id":"p17s3","text":"ulti/api/ports`, `/multi/api/status`, `/multi/api/stop`, `/multi/api/create`, `/multi/api/link`). No"},{"id":"p17s4","text":" existing slot is replaced, no line is rewritten, and no core session/agent/tool logic is touched.
-"},{"id":"p17s5","text":" **The UI is the official UI**: the wall is a view in the official view ring rendered inside the cha"},{"id":"p17s6","text":"t panel (not a popup). Theme, type scale, icons, and controls all use the official `--dsw-*` tokens "},{"id":"p17s7","text":"and official primitives (Button/Input/Menu/StateDot).
- **Recursion guard**: the wall never embeds i"},{"id":"p17s8","text":"ts own port; embedded pages carry a `?multi-wall=embed` flag and register no wall UI, preventing inf"},{"id":"p17s9","text":"inite "wall-in-wall" recursion.
- **Minimal footprint**: one declarative client plugin package — it "},{"id":"p17s10","text":"ships its own `dsh.bundle.patch` + `cordis.patch.yml`, so DSH mounts it as a bundle layer automatica"},{"id":"p17s11","text":"s its own `dsh.bundle.patch` + `cordis.patch.yml`, so DSH mounts it as a bundle layer automatically."},{"id":"p18s1","text":"## Directory layout"},{"id":"p19s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p20s1","text":"## Install & enable (Windows)"},{"id":"p21s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p22s1","text":"Or manual:"},{"id":"p23s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p24s1","text":"Uninstall (one command, nothing manual to clean up — restart `dsh web` to unload it):"},{"id":"p25s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p26s1","text":"## Usage"},{"id":"p27s1","text":"1. Start several instances: `.\scripts\start-multi.ps1 -Ports "3080,3081,3082,3084"` (or manual `dsh"},{"id":"p27s2","text":" web --port <n>`).
2. Open any instance and click the "Multi-window" shortcut in the sidebar footer "},{"id":"p27s3","text":"(or the "Multi-window" tab at the top of the chat area).
3. Inside the wall view: auto-discovery (ow"},{"id":"p27s4","text":"n port excluded), column switching (auto/1/2/3/4/6, horizontally filled by default), click title to "},{"id":"p27s5","text":"maximize, ⟳ refresh one, ↗ open in a new tab, ✕ remove from view, refresh all, and live online statu"},{"id":"p27s6","text":"s dots. The layout is persisted to `localStorage`.
4. To exit the wall, click the **"Exit" button in"},{"id":"p27s7","text":" the toolbar's top-right** to switch back to the chat view in one click."},{"id":"p28s1","text":"## Launch tokens (DSH 0.2)"},{"id":"p29s1","text":"Since DSH 0.2, every `dsh web` process mints a **launch token**, answers an unauthenticated `/` with"},{"id":"p29s2","text":" **401**, and only then serves the shell. An unauthenticated liveness probe therefore sees every rea"},{"id":"p29s3","text":"l instance as dead, and the wall stays empty."},{"id":"p30s1","text":"The wall presents the token automatically. `dsh-multi-chat start` reads each instance's token off it"},{"id":"p30s2","text":"s console and records it in `$DSH_HOME/multi-wall-instances.json`, which the node half picks up — no"},{"id":"p30s3","text":" configuration needed:"},{"id":"p31s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p32s1","text":"Instances you start **some other way** must be listed by hand, either by editing that same JSON file"},{"id":"p32s2","text":" or via the profile patch:"},{"id":"p33s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p34s1","text":"Tokens are per-process: restarting an instance mints a new one, so re-read it from that instance's s"},{"id":"p34s2","text":"tartup output. `dsh-multi-chat start` also keeps each instance's full console log in `$DSH_HOME/mult"},{"id":"p34s3","text":"i-wall-logs/instance-<port>.log`."},{"id":"p35s1","text":"## Phone / remote access (built-in authenticated gateway)"},{"id":"p36s1","text":"The official `dsh web` **deliberately forbids `--host 0.0.0.0`** (it would expose remote code execut"},{"id":"p36s2","text":"ion to the network). This plugin ships a built-in **token-authenticated intranet gateway**: click th"},{"id":"p36s3","text":"e "Phone access" button and it **automatically** starts a gateway for the current instance (listenin"},{"id":"p36s4","text":"g on `0.0.0.0`, reverse-proxying to `127.0.0.1:<this instance's port>`), returning a LAN URL + login"},{"id":"p36s5","text":".0.0.0`, reverse-proxying to `127.0.0.1:<this instance's port>`), returning a LAN URL + login token."},{"id":"p37s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p38s1","text":"[该节后续省略]"}],"truncated":true}
